newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Stora says stronger market boosts H1.
newsitem.headline: Stora says stronger market boosts H1.

text.p: Swedish forestry group Stora said on Tuesday that a stronger market drove delivery volumes up 10 percent in the first half of 1997 although lower prices capped its profits which fell 24 percent in the six months.
Stora posted a profit after financial items of 1.22 billion crowns, slightly above market expectations of 1.13 billion, and net sales of 22.02 billion crowns against 24.04 billion a year earlier.

It said its performance was improved by higher deliveries adding one billion crowns to its earnings, currency moves giving a 450 million crown boost and lower costs giving a benefit of 900 million crowns.
